text: Centre of frame: a conical-bottom graduated centrifuge tube (markings visible up to about 45 mL) held upright in a black clamp/holder mounted on a dark carbon-fibre-patterned panel. The tube has an orange screw cap in place and contains a red-pink liquid filling most of its volume. Above it, higher on the same panel, sits a white cylindrical component with a metal bracket and screws, below which is a red-orange block or holder with a dark slot. To the right is black machined equipment with a round dial bearing curved arrow markings, silver bolts, a white plastic block, a green vertical plate, and a grey dome-shaped sensor head on an arm. Left side: white panel and a pale vertical blind.
